summary: POS Workspace Responsive Architecture & World-Class Cashier UX: Split-screen tablet ergonomics, anti-clipping cart panel widths (330px+), adaptive multi-column catalog density (2 to 6 columns) for widescreen monitors, lean receipt bill summary (integrated total in checkout button, pure global discount isolation), and high-contrast Royal Blue cashier action psychology based on Indonesian POS benchmarks (Moka POS, Pawoon, Square).
